4452-5226-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-5226-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1753-4316-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3661-4053-4247-6989.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

799-3582-4772.easyPrerequisites: Kaya must be able to survive one turn cycle, or you control an additional legendary creature or planeswalker.
799-3582-4772.description:
Cast Kaya the Inexorable by paying {3}{W}{B}, causing her to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Kaya's last ability by removing seven loyalty counters, getting her emblem.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, the emblem triggers, allowing you to cast Karn's Temporal Sundering from hand, graveyard, or exile without paying its mana cost, gaining an extra turn after this one.
Repeat step 3 each turn.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3967-4186-5662--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-2557-4094-4826-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2207-4038-4613-7426.easyPrerequisites:
There is at least one +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta does not have summoning sickness.
2207-4038-4613-7426.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Elf.
2207-4038-4613-7426.description:
Activate Berta using Immaculate Magistrate's ability by tapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta for each Elf you control.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Berta using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1987-2510-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2510-6991.notablePrerequisites: There is an instant card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2510-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1292-1594-3117-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

141-1269-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-2438.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

341-2275-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2292-3593-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2292-3593-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

717-3017-4798-5686.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

177-1418-1615.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
177-1418-1615.description:
Put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting the ability.
Gorion and Lucky Clover trigger.
Resolve the Lucky Clover trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Gorion's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Vantress Visions, copying Gorion's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Gorion's trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Gorion's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

565-2871-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
565-2871-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving the nontoken Peregrine Drake +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

2998-4050-4231-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2998-4050-4231-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gluttonous Troll, adding {1}.
Gluttonous Troll dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Gluttonous Troll from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Gluttonous Troll enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Food, three Clue and three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1424-2335-3386.notablePrerequisites:
Born to Drive and Nurturing Presence attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
1424-2335-3386.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Barrenton Medic, giving Barrenton Medic +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

524-4835.description:
Cast Aether Storm.
Players can no longer cast creature spells, and Aether Storm cannot be destroyed due to players being unable to pay life to activate its ability.

2086-4050-4381.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding one mana of any color.
Kitchen Finks' persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with zero -1/-1 counters on it due to Grumgully.
Kitchen Finks entering the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

2525-2947-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Double, adding one mana of any color.
Body Double leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat.

406-1218-1525-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Tandem Lookout is paired with Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
406-1218-1525-4298.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Borborygmos +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Borborygmos triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 2.
